scope: All 1,205 ordinary English nonfoil-available Alpha, Beta, Unlimited and Revised printings; high-resolution Scryfall scans. Canonical size 488 by 680.
finding: Legacy search padding reaches header and artist-credit regions. Perturbing those regions changes every legacy profile. Clean bounded strips remain byte-identical after changing the entire interior on all 1,205 scans. This is a region-sensitivity test, not an assertion that every legacy sample contains a letter.
policy: Eight fixed calibration UUIDs per material. Previous Alpha/Beta/Revised cohort identities retained; Unlimited cohort selected before fitting. Separate disjoint strips fit, select model complexity, and certify. Additional affine freedom needs independent improvement. Certification only accepts/rejects; it never chooses a preferred pose. Per-card transforms affect comparison scans only.
validationDisclosure: Earlier-used validation printings are reused validation, not a fresh holdout. Search initialization was investigated on calibration Camouflage/Bayou and other observed outliers, then tested across the full fixed cohort. No individual renderer correction or relaxed confidence gate.

algorithm.name: bounded-clean-frame-profiles-multistart-v2
algorithm.normalization: Resize raw scan to canonical dimensions, then apply the frozen centered affine matrix with bilinear sampling. Raster replay uses exactly that two-stage path.
algorithm.transformMeaning: [a,b,c,d,tx,ty] maps source canonical points relative to card center: x2=a*x+c*y+tx; y2=b*x+d*y+ty. Rotation/shear parameter values are degrees.
algorithm.confidence: Mean of four side median normalized-gradient correlations; threshold 0.7 overall, at least 0.5 on every side and eight nonempty strips. Correlations are geometry indices, not whole-card accuracy percentages.
algorithm.selection: Multiple uniform starts and an independent-axis coarse seed avoid local bevel minima. Similarity/affine models require >=0.001 independent objective gain and residual RMS reduction of at least max(0.05 px,25%), without worse fitting residual.

review.scope: Largest accepted correction per material/set, all eight rejected scans, recovered cases and the small Beta Twiddle regression were inspected as frame-strip overlays. No subjective review override changes a rejected pose.
notes: Follow-up frame diagnostics find that Unlimited/Revised inner art and rules-box edges can still vary by 1–3 pixels while these outer strips agree. This report validates outer-strip registration only, not the entire printed interior. See early-core-frame-diagnostics.json before using these poses for new renderer calibration.
Weak lower black-frame edges and Beta land left bevels remain the rejection clusters.

Beta Twiddle selects a simpler uniform pose: certification objective falls 0.9545 to 0.9436 versus the first clean-strip trial, but improves over raw. Retained without using certification to select the earlier pose.
Warped outside-source pixels must remain unavailable coverage, not be mistaken for incorrect card borders in subsequent full-card scoring. Keep real observed corner-shape differences measurable.
